name: The Lottery Corporation Limited
summary: The Lottery Corporation Limited operates lottery and games in Australia. It operates in two segments, Lotteries and Keno. The company offers its products under The Lott, Powerball, Oz Lotto, TattsLotto, Saturday lotto, Gold Lotto, X Lotto, Set for Life, Weekday Windfall, Lucky Lotteries, Instant Scratch-Its, and Keno brand names. It sells its products through news agencies, convenience stores, and other retail outlets, as well as thelott.com and mobile app. The company was founded in 1881 and is based in Brisbane, Australia.
